versions.name: Camp Pellissippi

features.note: Hiking and backpacking legs on Winding Waters expeditions.
Winding Waters, a create-your-own expedition programme based out of this camp.
Open to participants at least fourteen years of age.
Lake frontage paddled by canoe and kayak.

versions.summary: Great Smoky Mountain Council camp on Norris Lake, serving as home base for the Winding Waters Adventures high-adventure program, offering mountain biking, backpacking, rock climbing, whitewater rafting, canoeing, and kayaking for older Scouts, Venturers, and Sea Scouts.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence). Only the Winding Waters section of that page describes this property; the COPE and Mountain Adventure sections belong to Camp Buck Toms and were excluded.
